description.value:
Trigger You would gain Ghost-Static above your Static Cell's capacity.

Area 10-foot emanation

Saving Throw Basic Reflex

The excess charge cannot be held, so it leaves. Each creature in the area takes 1d6 electricity damage per charge that would have exceeded your capacity, to a maximum of 5d6, with a basic Reflex save against your class DC. You take no damage from your own overflow; your Rig does. The excess charges are spent whether or not the burst does anything.
